sources.text:
Vendor evaluation: Warehouse management system tender

Scoring method: total = 60% technical score + 40% price score; vendors with a total below 70 are rejected.

Scoring table

| Vendor | Price | Technical score | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Northwind Systems | 48,000 | 82 | 78 |
| Contoso Build | 52,500 | 90 | 81 |
| Fabrikam Works | 44,900 | 74 | 71 |

Recommendation: award the contract to Contoso Build, the highest total.
